Description:
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/55767/55767-1795648403-590461135.jpg[/img]

[center][size=6][b]🌟 VALLEY BUDDIES — v5.7.2 (LIVING WORLD EDITION) 🌟[/b][/size]
[size=4][i]Bring Pelican Town villagers to physical life: companions, living spouses, farmhands, 18 living micro-events, 20 native cutscenes, cozy nightlife, camping, and cave expeditions![/i][/size]

[b]Current Version:[/b] 5.7.2 (Gold Stable Master)  |  [b]Author:[/b] Juxxan3
[b]Compatibility:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6.0+ (1.6.14 / 1.6.15 / 1.6.16+)  |  SMAPI 4.0.0+  |  100% Multiplayer Co-op
[b]Dependencies:[/b] 100% Standalone (Zero external requirements — optional AI bridge for [i]AliveNpcs 1.8.2+[/i])[/center]

[line]

[quote][b]💬 A Personal Note From the Author (Juxxan3):[/b]
Hey everyone! First, I want to apologize for pushing so many updates in such a short window—I know the update feed has been pretty flooded lately! I've just been super excited about all the ideas I've had in mind and couldn't wait to build and share them with all of you.

[b]Why the jump to v5.7.2?[/b] If you're updating from our earlier public Nexus builds (v3.0.0 / v4.0.1), you might notice the version number jumped straight to [b]5.7.2[/b]. That's because Valley Buddies went through an entire internal architectural rebuild (Level 3 Modular Engine) alongside several major content expansions—growing from ~425 dialogue keys to [b]1,600 fully localized lines[/b] across 11 languages, adding living town events, native cutscenes, and a complete forensic stability & Co-op audit. Syncing our Nexus release directly with our source code version ensures 100% update-key accuracy in SMAPI!

[b]This v5.7.2 release is by far our most stable build yet.[/b] From here on out, I am pausing big feature drops to focus purely on polishing and fixing any bugs based on your feedback. Thank you so much for your patience, testing, and support!

Join our discord! :  [url=https://discord.gg/gcvYVnprx]https://discord.gg/gcvYVnprx

[/url]Open Source Code (GitHub): [url=https://github.com/juxxan3/ValleyBuddies]https://github.com/juxxan3/ValleyBuddies[/url][/quote][line]

[size=5][b]⚡ WHAT'S NEW IN v5.7.2? (THE LIVING WORLD EXPANSION)[/b][/size]

Valley Buddies has evolved from a companion utility into a [b]comprehensive daily life, social, and immersion ecosystem[/b] built on a clean, modular engine. Here is everything waiting for you in v5.7.2:

[list]
[*][b]🏠 Living Home & Post-Marriage Spouse Routine:[/b]
 
[list]
 
[*][b]Tender Morning Kiss (06:00 – 07:00 AM):[/b] Start your day with gentle kisses, custom personality lines, and sweet sound effects before your spouse walks calmly to the kitchen.
  [/*]
[*][b]Homemade Breakfast Delivery (07:00 – 08:30 AM):[/b] Your spouse cooks fresh, piping-hot meals, delivers them right to your hands with a farewell embrace, or leaves them in the kitchen fridge with an affectionate note. They even learn new recipes by watching you cook!
  [/*]
[*][b]Workday Schedule Notice:[/b] On days when your spouse has a vanilla town job (Penny teaching Jas & Vincent, Maru or Harvey at the clinic, etc.), they warmly announce their workday with sequential speech bubbles around 08:00 AM, smoothly yielding to their vanilla schedule without conflicts.
  [/*]
[*][b]30-Minute Household Life Blocks:[/b] Your partner washes dishes (with real steam and soap bubbles), tidies up around the home with gentle sparkles, reads by the window, or relaxes in their unique custom spouse room (Sebastian's terrarium, Harvey's model planes, Emily's parrot, Shane's Charlie, Krobus' shadow relics, etc.).
  [/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]🌾 Real Farm Chores & Greenhouse Assistance:[/b]
  Spouses and hired companions water crops (including indoor flower pots and pet bowls), visit barns and coops to pet animals and collect animal products, tend to the greenhouse (with regrowable-crop safety checks), chop wood, clear debris, and harvest ripe produce—neatly depositing items into chests (including Big Chests) or handing them to you upon your return.
[/*]
[*][b]🗡️ Tactical Cave & Mine Expeditions (Caves 2.0):[/b]
 
[list]
 
[*][b]Combat Autonomy & Teamwork:[/b] In the Mines, Skull Cavern, and Volcano Dungeon, companions fight right alongside you. They select targets, break ores, spot ladders, evade bombs, and adapt to 4 tactical stances ([i]Aggressive, Balanced, Cautious, Support Healer[/i]). If exhausted, they step back to catch their breath.
  [/*]
[*][b]Dynamic Lighting & Safety:[/b] Companions equip lanterns or torches in dark floors to light your way, and will wisely wait at the cave entrance if your friendship level isn't high enough for extreme danger floors.
  [/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]🎬 Universal Native Cutscenes & 97 Personal Character Voices:[/b]
 
[list]
 
[*][b]20 Native Event Scenarios:[/b] Powered by Stardew Valley's native event system with zero save-file pollution—including Beach, Mountain, Forest, Saloon, Library, Museum, Secret Woods, Ginger Island, Railroad, Sewer, Golden Sunset, Rainy Night, and Winter Snow scenes.
  [/*]
[*][b]97 Custom Interactive Voices:[/b] Every single Vanilla villager (36), Stardew Valley Expanded NPC (17), and Ridgeside Village NPC (44) has bespoke dialogue, interactive choices, and relationship-aware reactions (Child-Safe, Friend, Close Friend, and Romance/Spouse), plus automatic archetype support for any custom mod NPC!
  [/*]
[*][b]Ambient Group Cutscenes:[/b] Enter town buildings and valley locations to witness lively, unscripted ambient cutscenes among villagers—and optionally chime in yourself!
  [/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]💫 18 Interactive Living Micro-Events & Smart Pacing:[/b]
 
[list]
 
[*][b]Dynamic Moments With Portraits:[/b] Experience 18 organic events with expressive character portraits ([i]Burned Breakfast, Kitchen Taste Test, House Bug Scare, Shiny Farm Find, Rainy Chill Break, Mischievous Animal, Town Craving, Trail Stumble, Spontaneous Sunset View, Four-Leaf Clover, Firefly Wish, Wildflower Crown, Street Music Hum, Snowball Play, Stargazing Wish, Shared Umbrella, Home Snack Craving, and Farm Work Cheering[/i])—complete with choices, buffs, and rewards!
  [/*]
[*][b]Built-in Pacing Director:[/b] Choose between [i]Relaxed, Balanced, or Lively[/i] presets in GMCM so events feel natural and never spammy.
  [/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]🏘️ 4-Layer "Living Town" Simulation:[/b]
  Even when villagers aren't following you, Pelican Town feels alive: neighbors hold multi-turn conversations ([i]Ambient Town Banter[/i]), share spontaneous personal thoughts ([i]Ambient Chatter[/i]), greet you warmly as you walk past ([i]Pass-By Greetings[/i]), and act out real-time scenic vignettes around the valley—with optional localized chat transcript echo!
[/*]
[*][b]🧺 Real Picnic 2.0, Reverse Invitations & Cozy Sleepovers:[/b]
[list]
 
[*][b]Persistent Picnic 2.0:[/b] Spread a checkered picnic blanket with personality-themed snacks anywhere outdoors for passive stamina recovery until you decide to pack up.
  [/*]
[*][b]Reverse Invitations & Surprise Dates:[/b] Single friends (4+ hearts) visit your farmhouse porch to invite you out to their favorite spots, and your spouse can surprise you with breakfast dates.
  [/*]
[*][b]Tucked-in Sleepovers & Starlit Camping:[/b] Guests explore your home at night, slip neatly under the blanket covers of Single or Double beds with floating [i]Zzz[/i] emotes, or pitch a tent and campfire under the stars—sending a morning coffee thank-you letter to your mailbox!
  [/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]🌐 Full Host-Authoritative Multiplayer Co-op:[/b]
  Zero rubber-banding, jitter, or duplicate audio/particle loops. Farmhands can recruit companions, assign chores, host sleepovers in their own cabins, trigger events, and coordinate cave tactics seamlessly while the Host maintains full physical authority over NPC movement.
[/*]
[*][b]🌍 Exhaustive Global Localization (1,600 Keys):[/b]
  Expanded from 425 to [b]1,600 lines[/b] with 100% token and key parity across all 11 official game languages.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]📖 WHAT IS VALLEY BUDDIES?[/b][/size]

Ever wished Pelican Town villagers weren't just static dialogue portraits? When a friend or spouse says [i]"Let me help you out on the farm!"[/i] or [i]"Let's go explore the woods!"[/i], shouldn't they physically walk by your side and actually do it?

[b]Valley Buddies[/b] grants villagers genuine physical agency in the world of Stardew Valley. It operates [b]100% standalone (no external dependencies required)[/b], featuring its own native recruitment system and 1,600 handcrafted dialogue lines, while also offering seamless, automatic integration with AI conversation mods like [b]AliveNpcs (including full AliveNpcs 1.8.1 & 1.8.2+ reflection compatibility)[/b] if installed.

[line]

[size=5][b]🎮 CONTROLS & HOW TO RECRUIT[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]⌨️ Quick Recruit / Action Hub Hotkey:[/b] Press [b]LeftShift + E[/b] (Default, fully rebindable in GMCM) near any eligible villager to invite them instantly or open their Action Menu ([i]Follow, Farm Chores, Social Activities, Cave Tactics, Sleepover/Camp, Dismiss[/i]).[/*]
[*][b]💬 Post-Dialogue Invite Prompt:[/b] In Standalone mode, finishing a regular conversation with an eligible villager naturally presents an invite prompt.[/*]
[*][b]🖱️ Right-Click Interaction:[/b] Right-click on your active companion at any time to open their Action Menu.[/*]
[*][b]🚪 Quick Dismiss Key:[/b] Press [b]End[/b] (Default, rebindable) to dismiss your followers; they will wave goodbye and safely resume their daily schedule.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]⚠️ REQUIREMENTS & COMPATIBILITY[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/b] (Verified on 1.6.9, 1.6.14, 1.6.15, and 1.6.16+).[/*]
[*][b]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/b] (Required).[/*]
[*][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] [i](Highly Recommended):[/i] Organized into a clean Quick-Start dashboard + 5 modular sub-pages (Immersion, Home, Outings, Farm & Combat, Advanced) to customize hotkeys, pacing presets, search radiuses, and toggles in-game.[/*]
[*][b]AliveNpcs (by Lucas)[/b] [i](100% Optional):[/i] Valley Buddies runs completely standalone without it. If installed, AI memories, dynamic reactions, and group conversations (updated for AliveNpcs 1.8.2+) connect automatically.[/*]
[/list][line]

[size=5][b]🌐 FULLY TRANSLATED INTO 11 LANGUAGES (1,600 KEYS)[/b][/size]

Automatically matches your Stardew Valley language setting with [b]1,600 handcrafted keys per language[/b]:
🇺🇸 English  •  🇪🇸 Español  •  🇧🇷 Português (BR)  •  🇨🇳 简体中文  •  🇷🇺 Русский  •  🇩🇪 Deutsch  •  🇫🇷 Français  •  🇮🇹 Italiano  •  🇯🇵 日本語  •  🇰🇷 한국어
